Model Input Generation Pipeline#

Pipeline of bash scripts to generate base resolution, normlised bigwig files for model training and finetuning.

1. ATAC inputs#

Takes pseudobulked ATAC .bam files and sets up a SLURM array job to compute base-resolution ATAC bigwigs (+4/-4 shift) for AlphaGenome/Borzoi. Reads are normalized to 100M counts per .bw file. Optionally filters pseudobulks based on a minimum cell count. Assumes DEDUPLICATED .bam files. Input: BAM_DIR and (optional) CELL_NUMBER_FILE metadata. Output: Generates job configs and submits make_ATAC_bw.slurm array jobs.

src/model_input_prep/01_submit_ATAC_BigWig_prep.sh#
  1#!/bin/bash
  2# ==============================================================================
  3# Code by Jakob
  4# 
  5# Purpose: Takes pseudobulked ATAC .bam files and sets up a SLURM array job to 
  6#          compute base-resolution ATAC bigwigs (+4/-4 shift) for AlphaGenome/Borzoi.
  7#          Reads are normalized to 100M counts per .bw file.
  8#          Optionally filters pseudobulks based on a minimum cell count.
  9#          Assumes DEDUPLICATED .bam files.
 10# Input:   BAM_DIR and (optional) CELL_NUMBER_FILE metadata.
 11# Output:  Generates job configs and submits make_ATAC_bw.slurm array jobs.
 12# ==============================================================================
 13
 14# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15# I/O & Parameters
 16# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17BASE_DIR="../.."
 18BAM_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/input_data/raw_bam/multiome_ATAC"
 19BW_OUTPUT_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/input_data/AlphaGenome_Borzoi_input/multiome_ATAC_bigwig_deduplicated"
 20
 21# Define pseudobulks using cell type (contained in file name). Use "all" to process the whole directory.
 22CELL_TYPES=("all") 
 23
 24# Optional Filtering: Set CELL_NUMBER_FILE="" to disable filtering entirely.
 25CELL_NUMBER_FILE="configs/nCells.csv" 
 26N_CELLS=400   
 27
 28# Config & Logging files
 29CONFIG_FILE="configs/valid_ATAC_pseudobulks.txt"
 30LOG_FILE="configs/submitted_ATAC_pseudobulks.txt"
 31
 32# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33# Execution
 34# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35
 36# Clear previous run logs
 37> "$CONFIG_FILE"
 38> "$LOG_FILE"
 39
 40# Redirect all stdout + stderr to both the console and the log file simultaneously
 41exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1
 42
 43# Resolve "all" to actual cell types by scanning the directory
 44if [[ "${CELL_TYPES[0],,}" == "all" ]]; then
 45    declare -A UNIQUE_CELL_TYPES
 46    for bam in "$BAM_DIR"/*.bam; do
 47        if [[ -f "$bam" ]]; then
 48            CT_NAME=$(basename "$bam" .bam)
 49            UNIQUE_CELL_TYPES["$CT_NAME"]=1
 50        fi
 51    done
 52    CELL_TYPES=("${!UNIQUE_CELL_TYPES[@]}")
 53fi
 54
 55echo "Scanning for valid data combinations..."
 56printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "CELL_TYPE" "CELLS" "STATUS"
 57echo "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------"
 58
 59for CELL_TYPE in "${CELL_TYPES[@]}"; do
 60    BAM_FILE="${BAM_DIR}/${CELL_TYPE}.bam"
 61
 62    # 1. Verify the BAM file exists
 63    if [[ -f "$BAM_FILE" ]]; then
 64        
 65        # 2. Check if we should apply metadata filtering
 66        if [[ -n "$CELL_NUMBER_FILE" && -f "$CELL_NUMBER_FILE" ]]; then
 67            # Extract cell count from the CSV
 68            CELL_COUNT=$(awk -F',' -v col="n_cells" -v ct="$CELL_TYPE" '
 69            NR==1 {
 70                for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) {
 71                    gsub(/"/, "", $i); # Remove quotes from header
 72                    if($i == col) col=i;
 73                }
 74            }
 75            NR>1 {
 76                gsub(/"/, "", $NF); # Remove quotes from cell type column
 77                if($NF == ct && col) {
 78                    print $col;
 79                }
 80            }' "$CELL_NUMBER_FILE")
 81
 82            CELL_COUNT=${CELL_COUNT:-0}
 83
 84            # Apply thresholds
 85            if (( CELL_COUNT >= N_CELLS )); then
 86                echo "$CELL_TYPE" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
 87                printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "$CELL_COUNT" "KEPT"
 88            else
 89                printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "$CELL_COUNT" "SKIPPED (Filtered)"
 90            fi
 91        else
 92            # 3. Bypass Filtering: Keep everything
 93            echo "$CELL_TYPE" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
 94            printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "N/A" "KEPT (No Filter)"
 95        fi
 96        
 97    else
 98        printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "N/A" "SKIPPED (Missing BAM)"
 99    fi
100done
101
102echo "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------"
103
104NUM_JOBS=$(wc -l < "$CONFIG_FILE")
105
106if [ "$NUM_JOBS" -eq 0 ]; then
107    echo "Error: No combinations passed the checks. Exiting."
108    exit 1
109fi
110
111echo "Found $NUM_JOBS valid combinations. Submitting Slurm array job..."
112
113# Launch the array job, passing our dynamic directories and config path as arguments!
114sbatch --array=1-$NUM_JOBS ../utils/preprocessing/make_ATAC_bw.slurm "$BAM_DIR" "$BW_OUTPUT_DIR" "$CONFIG_FILE"

2. RNA inputs#

Takes pseudobulked scRNA .bam files and sets up a SLURM array job to compute base-resolution bigwigs for AlphaGenome/Borzoi. Reads are split by strand and both strands sum to 100M counts per pseudobulk. Optionally filters pseudobulks based on a minimum cell count. Assumes DEDUPLICATED .bam files. Input: BAM_DIR and (optional) CELL_NUMBER_FILE metadata. Output: Generates job configs and submits make_RNA_3prime_bw.slurm array jobs.

 60

 68            # Extract cell count

 70            NR==1 {
 71                for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) {
 72                    gsub(/"/, "", $i);
 73                    if($i == col) col=i;
 74                }
 75            }
 76            NR>1 {
 77                gsub(/"/, "", $NF);
 78                if($NF == ct && col) {
 79                    print $col;
 80                }
 81            }' "$CELL_NUMBER_FILE")
 82
 83            CELL_COUNT=${CELL_COUNT:-0}
 84
 85            # Apply Filter
 86            if (( CELL_COUNT >= N_CELLS )); then
 87                echo "$CELL_TYPE" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
 88                printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "$CELL_COUNT" "KEPT"
 89            else
 90                printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "$CELL_COUNT" "SKIPPED (Filtered)"
 91            fi
 92        else
 93            # 3. Bypass Filtering
 94            echo "$CELL_TYPE" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"
 95            printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "N/A" "KEPT (No Filter)"
 96        fi
 97        
 98    else
 99        printf "%-35s %-10s %-15s\n" "$CELL_TYPE" "N/A" "SKIPPED (No BAM)"
100    fi
101done
102
103echo "----------------------------------------------------------------------"
104
105NUM_JOBS=$(wc -l < "$CONFIG_FILE")
106

108    echo "Error: No combinations passed the filtering thresholds. Exiting."

110fi

116sbatch --array=1-$NUM_JOBS ../utils/preprocessing/make_RNA_3prime_bw.slurm "$BAM_DIR" "$BW_OUTPUT_DIR" "$CONFIG_FILE"

3. CutnTag inputs#

Takes bulk Cut&Tag .bam files and sets up a SLURM array job to compute base-resolution bigwigs for AlphaGenome/Borzoi. Leverages chromBPNet derived pipeline and transfers it to Cut&Tag. Reads are normalized to 100M counts per .bw file. Input: INPUT_SOURCE can be either:

  1. A directory path (will scan for all .bam files)

  2. A text file containing manually curated full paths to .bam files

Output: Generates job configs and submits make_CutnTag_bw.slurm array jobs.

src/model_input_prep/03_submit_CutnTag_BigWig_prep.sh#
 1#!/bin/bash
 2# ==============================================================================
 3# Code by Jakob
 4# 
 5# Purpose: Takes bulk Cut&Tag .bam files and sets up a SLURM array job to 
 6#          compute base-resolution bigwigs for AlphaGenome/Borzoi. 
 7#          Leverages chromBPNet derived pipeline and transfers it to Cut&Tag.
 8#          Reads are normalized to 100M counts per .bw file.
 9# Input:   INPUT_SOURCE can be either:
10#          1. A directory path (will scan for all .bam files)
11#          2. A text file containing manually curated full paths to .bam files
12# Output:  Generates job configs and submits make_CutnTag_bw.slurm array jobs.
13# ==============================================================================
14
15# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
16# I/O & Parameters
17# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
18BASE_DIR="../.."
19BW_OUTPUT_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/input_data/AlphaGenome_Borzoi_input/CutnTag_bigwig"
20
21# Set this to EITHER a directory OR a .txt file
22INPUT_SOURCE="utils/preprocessing/valid_CutnTag_bams.txt" 
23# Example directory usage: INPUT_SOURCE="${BASE_DIR}/input_data/raw_bam/CutnTag"
24
25# Temporary config file that the array job will actually read
26RUN_CONFIG="utils/preprocessing/running_CutnTag_bams.txt"
27LOG_FILE="utils/preprocessing/submitted_CutnTag.txt"
28
29# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30# Execution
31# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32
33# Clear previous files
34> "$RUN_CONFIG"
35> "$LOG_FILE"
36
37exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1
38
39echo "======================================================================"
40echo "Evaluating Input Source: $INPUT_SOURCE"
41echo "======================================================================"
42
43# Determine if the input is a directory or a file
44if [[ -d "$INPUT_SOURCE" ]]; then
45    echo "Mode: Directory detected. Scanning for .bam files..."
46    find "$INPUT_SOURCE" -type f -name "*.bam" > "$RUN_CONFIG"
47    
48elif [[ -f "$INPUT_SOURCE" ]]; then
49    echo "Mode: Config file detected. Copying manually curated paths..."
50    # Filter out empty lines just in case
51    grep -v '^$' "$INPUT_SOURCE" > "$RUN_CONFIG"
52    
53else
54    echo "Error: INPUT_SOURCE is neither a valid directory nor a file."
55    exit 1
56fi
57
58echo "----------------------------------------------------------------------"
59# Show a preview of the files queued for processing
60head -n 5 "$RUN_CONFIG"
61echo "... (showing up to 5 paths)"
62echo "----------------------------------------------------------------------"
63
64NUM_JOBS=$(wc -l < "$RUN_CONFIG")
65
66if [ "$NUM_JOBS" -eq 0 ]; then
67    echo "Error: No BAM files found. Exiting."
68    exit 1
69fi
70
71echo "Found $NUM_JOBS Cut&Tag samples. Submitting Slurm array job..."
72
73# Launch as array job, passing the output dir and the active config file
74sbatch --array=1-$NUM_JOBS ../utils/preprocessing/make_CutnTag_bw.slurm "$BW_OUTPUT_DIR" "$RUN_CONFIG"
